sections.label: A prayer to Vachaspati for divine illumination and help
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 1

verses.sa:
ये त्रिषप्ताः परियन्ति विश्वा रूपाणि बिभ्रतः ।
वाचस्पतिर्बला तेषां तन्वो अद्य दधातु मे॥
verses.tr: ye triṣaptāḥ pariyanti viśvā rūpāṇi bibhrataḥ vācaspatirbalā teṣāṃ tanvo adya dadhātu me
verses.en: Now may Vachaspati assign to me the strength and powers of Those Who, wearing every shape and form, the triple seven, are wandering round.

verses.sa:
पुनरेहि वचस्पते देवेन मनसा सह।
वसोष्पते नि रमय मय्येवास्तु मयि श्रुतम्॥
verses.tr: punarehi vacaspate devena manasā saha vasoṣpate ni ramaya mayyevāstu mayi śrutam
verses.en: Come thou again, Vachaspati, come with divine intelligence. Vasoshpati, repose thou here. In me be Knowledge, yea, in me.

verses.sa:
इहैवाभि वि तनूभे आर्त्नी इव ज्यया ।
वाचस्पतिर्नि यच्छतु मय्येवास्तु मयि श्रुतम्॥
verses.tr: ihaivābhi vi tanūbhe ārtnī iva jyayā vācaspatirni yacchatu mayyevāstu mayi śrutam
verses.en: Here, even here, spread sheltering arms like the two bow-ends strained with cord. This let Vachaspati confirm. In me be Knowledge, yea, in me.

verses.sa:
उपहूतो वाचस्पतिरुपास्मान् वाचस्पतिर्ह्वयताम्।
सं श्रुतेन गमेमहि मा श्रुतेन वि राधिषि॥
verses.tr: upahūto vācaspatirupāsmān vācaspatirhvayatām saṃ śrutena gamemahi mā śrutena vi rādhiṣi
verses.en: Vachaspati hath been invoked: may he invite us in reply. May we adhere to Sacred Lore. Never may I be reft thereof.

sections.label: A charm against dysentery
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 2

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं पर्जन्यं भूरिधायसम्।
विद्मो ष्वस्य मातरं पृथिवीं भूरिवर्पसम्॥
verses.tr: vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ parjanyaṃ bhūridhāyasam vidmo ṣvasya mātaraṃ pṛthivīṃ bhūrivarpasam
verses.en: We know the father of the shaft, Parjanya, liberal nourisher, Know well his mother; Prithivi, Earth with her manifold designs.

verses.sa:
ज्याऽके परि णो नमाश्मानं तन्वं कृधि ।
वीडुर्वरीयोऽरातीरप द्वेषांस्याऽकृधि॥
verses.tr: jyā'ke pari ṇo namāśmānaṃ tanvaṃ kṛdhi vīḍurvarīyo'rātīrapa dveṣāṃsyā'kṛdhi
verses.en: Do thou, O Bowstring, bend thyself around us: make my body stone. Firm in thy strength drive far away malignities and hateful things.

verses.sa:
वृक्षं यद्गावः परिषस्वजाना अनुस्फुरं शरमर्चन्त्यृभुम्।
शरुमस्मद्यावय दिद्युमिन्द्र॥
verses.tr: vṛkṣaṃ yadgāvaḥ pariṣasvajānā anusphuraṃ śaramarcantyṛbhum śarumasmadyāvaya didyumindra
verses.en: When, closely clinging round the wood, the bowstring sings triumph to the swift and whizzing arrow, Indra, ward off from us the shaft, the missile.

verses.sa:
यथा द्यां च पृथिवीं चान्तस्तिष्ठति तेजनम्।
एवा रोगं चास्रावं चान्तस्तिष्ठतु मुञ्ज इत्॥
verses.tr: yathā dyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāntastiṣṭhati tejanam evā rogaṃ cāsrāvaṃ cāntastiṣṭhatu muñja it
verses.en: As in its flight the arrow's point hangs between earth and firmament, So stand this Munja grass between ailment and dysenteric ill!

sections.label: A charm against constipation and suppression of urine
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 3

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं पर्जन्यं शतवृष्ण्यम् ।
तेना ते तन्वे३शं करं पृथिव्यां ते निषेचनं बहिष्टे अस्तु बालिति॥
verses.tr: vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ parjanyaṃ śatavṛṣṇyam tenā te tanve3śaṃ karaṃ pṛthivyāṃ te niṣecanaṃ bahiṣṭe astu bāliti
verses.en: We know the father of the shaft, Parjanya strong with hundred powers: By this may I bring health unto thy body: let the channels pour their burthen freely as of old.

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं मित्रं शतवृष्ण्यम् ।
तेना ते तन्वे३ शं करं पृथिव्यां ते निषेचनं बहिष्टे अस्तु बालिति॥
verses.tr: vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ mitraṃ śatavṛṣṇyam tenā te tanve3 śaṃ karaṃ pṛthivyāṃ te niṣecanaṃ bahiṣṭe astu bāliti
verses.en: We know the father of the shaft, Mitra, the Lord of hundred powers: By this, etc.

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं वरुणं शतवृष्ण्यम् ।
तेना ते तन्वे३ शं करं पृथिव्यां ते निषेचनं बहिष्टे अस्तु बालिति॥
verses.tr: vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ varuṇaṃ śatavṛṣṇyam tenā te tanve3 śaṃ karaṃ pṛthivyāṃ te niṣecanaṃ bahiṣṭe astu bāliti
verses.en: We know the father of the shaft, Varuna, strong with hundred powers: By this, etc.

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं चन्द्रं शतवृष्ण्यम् ।
तेना ते तन्वे३ शं करं पृथिव्यां ते निषेचनं बहिष्टे अस्तु बालिति॥
verses.tr: vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ candraṃ śatavṛṣṇyam tenā te tanve3 śaṃ karaṃ pṛthivyāṃ te niṣecanaṃ bahiṣṭe astu bāliti
verses.en: We know the father of the shaft, the Moon endowed with hundred powers: By this, etc.

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं सूर्यं शतवृष्ण्यम् ।
तेना ते तन्वे३ शं करं पृथिव्यां ते निषेचनं बहिष्टे अस्तु बालिति॥
verses.tr: vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ sūryaṃ śatavṛṣṇyam tenā te tanve3 śaṃ karaṃ pṛthivyāṃ te niṣecanaṃ bahiṣṭe astu bāliti
verses.en: We know the father of the shaft, the Sun endowed with hundred powers: By this may I bring health unto thy body: let the channels pour their burthen freely as of old.

verses.sa:
यदान्त्रेषु गवीन्योर्यद्वस्तावधि संश्रुतम् ।
एवा ते मूत्रं मुच्यतां बहिर्बालिति सर्वकम्॥
verses.tr: yadāntreṣu gavīnyoryadvastāvadhi saṃśrutam evā te mūtraṃ mucyatāṃ bahirbāliti sarvakam
verses.en: Whate'er hath gathered, as it flowed, in bowels, bladder, or in groins, Thus let the conduit, free from check, pour all its. burthen as of old.

verses.sa:
प्र ते भिनद्मि मेहनं वर्त्रं वेशन्त्या इव ।
एवा ते मूत्रं मुच्यतां बहिर्बालिति सर्वकम्॥
verses.tr: pra te bhinadmi mehanaṃ vartraṃ veśantyā iva evā te mūtraṃ mucyatāṃ bahirbāliti sarvakam
verses.en: I lay the passage open as one cleaves the dam that bars the lake: Thus let, etc.

verses.sa:
विषितं ते वस्तिबिलं समुद्रस्योदधेरिव ।
एवा ते मूत्रं मुच्यतां बहिर्बालिति सर्वकम्॥
verses.tr: viṣitaṃ te vastibilaṃ samudrasyodadheriva evā te mūtraṃ mucyatāṃ bahirbāliti sarvakam
verses.en: Now hath the portal been unclosed as of the sea that holds the flood: Thus let, etc.

verses.sa:
यथेषुका परापतदवसृष्टाधि धन्वनः ।
एवा ते मूत्रं मुच्यतां बहिर्बालिति सर्वकम्॥
verses.tr: yatheṣukā parāpatadavasṛṣṭādhi dhanvanaḥ evā te mūtraṃ mucyatāṃ bahirbāliti sarvakam
verses.en: Even as the arrow flies away when loosened from the archer's bow, Thus let the burthen be discharged from channels that are checked no more.

sections.label: To the Waters, for the prosperity of cattle
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 4

verses.sa: अम्बयो यन्त्यध्वभिर्जामयो अध्वरीयताम्। पृञ्चतीर्मधुना पयः॥
verses.tr: ambayo yantyadhvabhirjāmayo adhvarīyatām pṛñcatīrmadhunā payaḥ
verses.en: Along their paths the Mothers go, sisters of priestly ministrants, Blending their water with the mead.

verses.sa: अमूर्या उप सूर्ये याभिर्वा सूर्यः सह। ता नो हिन्वन्त्वध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: amūryā upa sūrye yābhirvā sūryaḥ saha tā no hinvantvadhvaram
verses.en: May yonder Waters near the Sun, or those wherewith the Sun is joined, Send forth this sacrifice of ours.

verses.sa: अपो देवीरुप ह्वये यत्र गावः पिबन्ति नः । सिन्धुभ्यः कर्त्वं हविः॥
verses.tr: apo devīrupa hvaye yatra gāvaḥ pibanti naḥ sindhubhyaḥ kartvaṃ haviḥ
verses.en: I call the Waters, Goddesses, hitherward where our cattle drink: The streams must share the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अप्स्व१न्तरमृतमप्सु भेषजम्।
अपामुत प्रशस्तिभिरश्वा भवथ वाजिनो गावो भवथ वाजिनीः॥
verses.tr: apsva1ntaramṛtamapsu bheṣajam apāmuta praśastibhiraśvā bhavatha vājino gāvo bhavatha vājinīḥ
verses.en: Amrit is in the Waters, in the Waters balm. Yea, through our praises of the Floods, O horses, be ye fleet and strong, and, O ye kine, be full of strength.

sections.label: To the Waters, for strength and power
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 5

verses.sa: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन । महे रणाय चक्षसे॥
verses.tr: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana mahe raṇāya cakṣase
verses.en: Ye, Waters, truly bring us bliss: so help ye us to strength and power That we may look on great delight.

verses.sa: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः । उशतीरिव मातरः॥
verses.tr: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ uśatīriva mātaraḥ
verses.en: Here grant to us a share of dew, that most auspicious dew of yours, Like mothers in their longing love.

verses.sa: तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ । आपो जनयथा च नः॥
verses.tr: tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha āpo janayathā ca naḥ
verses.en: For you we fain would go to him to whose abode ye send us forth, And, Waters, give us procreant strength.

verses.sa: ईशाना वार्याणां क्षयन्तीश्चर्षणीनाम्। अपो याचामि भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: īśānā vāryāṇāṃ kṣayantīścarṣaṇīnām apo yācāmi bheṣajam
verses.en: I pray the Floods to send us balm, those who bear rule o'er precious things, And have supreme control of men.

sections.label: To the Waters, for health and wealth
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 6

verses.sa: शं नो देवीरभिष्टय आपो भवन्तु पीतये । शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye śaṃ yorabhi sravantu naḥ
verses.en: The Waters be to us for drink, Goddesses, for our aid and bliss: Let them stream health and wealth to us.

verses.sa: अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा।अग्निं च विश्वशं भुवम्॥
verses.tr: apsu me somo abravīdantarviśvāni bheṣajāagniṃ ca viśvaśaṃ bhuvam
verses.en: Within the Waters—Soma thus hath told me—dwell all balms that heal, And Agni, he who blesseth all.

verses.sa: आपः पृणीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे३ मम । ज्योक् च सूर्यं दृशे॥
verses.tr: āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve3 mama jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe
verses.en: O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm, So that I long may see the Sun.

verses.sa:
शं न आपो धन्वन्या३ शमु सन्त्वनूप्याः ।
शं नः खनित्रिमा आपः शमु याः कुम्भ आभृताः शिवा नः सन्तु वार्षिकीः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ na āpo dhanvanyā3 śamu santvanūpyāḥ śaṃ naḥ khanitrimā āpaḥ śamu yāḥ kumbha ābhṛtāḥ śivā naḥ santu vārṣikīḥ
verses.en: The Waters bless us, all that rise in desert lands or marshy pools! Bless us the Waters dug from earth, bless us the Waters brought in jars, bless us the Waters of the Rains!

sections.label: To Indra and Agni, for the detection and destruction of evil spirits
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 7

verses.sa:
स्तुवानमग्न आ वह यातुधानं किमीदिनम्।
त्वं हि देव वन्दितो हन्ता दस्योर्बभूविथ॥
verses.tr: stuvānamagna ā vaha yātudhānaṃ kimīdinam tvaṃ hi deva vandito hantā dasyorbabhūvitha
verses.en: Bring the Kimidin hither, bring the Yatudhana self-declared, For Agni, God, thou, lauded, hast become the Dasyu's slaughterer.

verses.sa:
आज्यस्य परमेष्ठिन् जातवेदस्तनूवशिन्।
अग्ने तौलस्य प्राशान यातुधानान् वि लापय॥
verses.tr: ājyasya parameṣṭhin jātavedastanūvaśin agne taulasya prāśāna yātudhānān vi lāpaya
verses.en: O Jatavedas, Lord Supreme, controller of our bodies, taste; The butter, Agni, taste the oil: make thou the Yatudhanas mourn.

verses.sa:
वि लपन्तु यातुधाना अत्त्रिणो ये किमीदिनः ।
अथेदमग्ने नो हविरिन्द्रश्च प्रति हर्यतम्॥
verses.tr: vi lapantu yātudhānā attriṇo ye kimīdinaḥ athedamagne no havirindraśca prati haryatam
verses.en: Let Yatudhanas mourn, let all greedy Kimidins weep and wail: And, Agni, Indra, may ye both accept this sacrifice of ours.

verses.sa:
अग्नि पूर्व आ रभतां प्रेन्द्रो नुदतु बाहुमान्।
ब्रवीतु सर्वो यातुमानयमस्मीत्येत्य॥
verses.tr: agni pūrva ā rabhatāṃ prendro nudatu bāhumān bravītu sarvo yātumānayamasmītyetya
verses.en: May Agni seize upon them first, may strong-armed Indra drive them forth: Let every wicked sorcerer come hither and say, Here am I.

verses.sa:
पश्याम ते वीर्यं जातवेदः प्र णो ब्रूहि यातुधानान् नृचक्षः ।
त्वया सर्वे परितप्ताः पुरस्तात्त आ यन्तु प्रब्रुवाणा उपेदम्॥
verses.tr: paśyāma te vīryaṃ jātavedaḥ pra ṇo brūhi yātudhānān nṛcakṣaḥ tvayā sarve paritaptāḥ purastātta ā yantu prabruvāṇā upedam
verses.en: Let us behold thy strength, O Jatavedas. Viewer of men, tell us the Yatudhanas. Burnt by thy heat and making declaration let all approach this sacrifice before thee.

verses.sa:
आ रभस्व जातवेदोऽस्माकार्थाय जज्ञिषे ।
दूतो नो अग्ने भूत्वा यातुधानान् वि लापय॥
verses.tr: ā rabhasva jātavedo'smākārthāya jajñiṣe dūto no agne bhūtvā yātudhānān vi lāpaya
verses.en: O Jatavedas, seize on them: for our advantage art thou born: Agni, be thou our messenger and make the Yatudhanas wail.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने यातुधानानुपबद्धाँ इहा वह ।
अथैषामिन्द्रो वज्रेणापि शीर्षाणि वृश्चतु॥
verses.tr: tvamagne yātudhānānupabaddhāṃ ihā vaha athaiṣāmindro vajreṇāpi śīrṣāṇi vṛścatu
verses.en: O Agni, bring thou hitherward the Yatudhanas bound and chained, And afterward let Indra tear their heads off with his thunderbolt.

sections.label: To Indra, Brihaspati, Soma and Agni, for the destruction of sorcerers
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 8

verses.sa:
इदं हविर्यातुधानान् नदी फेनमिवा वहत्।
य इदं स्त्री पुमानकरिह स स्तुवतां जनः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ haviryātudhānān nadī phenamivā vahat ya idaṃ strī pumānakariha sa stuvatāṃ janaḥ
verses.en: This sacrifice shall bring the Yatudhanas as the flood brings foam: Here let the doer of this deed, woman or man, acknowledge it.

verses.sa:
अयं स्तुवान आगमदिमं स्म प्रति हर्यत ।
बृहस्पते वशे लब्ध्वाग्नीषोमा वि विध्यतम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ stuvāna āgamadimaṃ sma prati haryata bṛhaspate vaśe labdhvāgnīṣomā vi vidhyatam
verses.en: This one hath come confessing all: do ye receive him eagerly. Master him thou, Brihaspati; Agni and Soma, pierce him through.

verses.sa:
यातुधानस्य सोमप जहि प्रजां नयस्व च ।
नि स्तुवानस्य पातय परमक्ष्युतावरम्॥
verses.tr: yātudhānasya somapa jahi prajāṃ nayasva ca ni stuvānasya pātaya paramakṣyutāvaram
verses.en: O Soma-drinker, strike and bring the Yatudhana's progeny: Make the confessing sinner's eyes fall from his head, both right and left.

verses.sa:
यत्रैषामग्ने जनिमानि वेत्थ गुहा सतामत्त्रिणां जातवेदः ।
तांस्त्वं ब्रह्मणा वावृधानो जह्येऽषां शततर्हमग्ने॥
verses.tr: yatraiṣāmagne janimāni vettha guhā satāmattriṇāṃ jātavedaḥ tāṃstvaṃ brahmaṇā vāvṛdhāno jahye'ṣāṃ śatatarhamagne
verses.en: As thou, O "Agni Jatavedas, knowest the races of these secret greedy beings, So strengthened by the power of prayer, O Agni, crushing them down a hundred times destroy them.

sections.label: Benediction on a King at his inauguration
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 9

verses.sa:
अस्मिन् वसु वसवो धारयन्त्विन्द्रः पूषा वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ।
इममादित्या उत विश्वे च देवा उत्तरस्मिन् ज्योतिषि धारयन्तु॥
verses.tr: asmin vasu vasavo dhārayantvindraḥ pūṣā varuṇo mitro agniḥ imamādityā uta viśve ca devā uttarasmin jyotiṣi dhārayantu
verses.en: May Indra, Pushan, Varuna, Mitra, Agni, benignant Gods, maintain this man in riches. May the Adityas and the Visve Devas set and support him in supremest lustre.

verses.sa:
अस्य देवाः प्रदिशि ज्योतिरस्तु सूर्यो अग्निरुत वा हिरण्यम्।
सपत्ना अस्मदधरे भवन्तूत्तमं नाकमधि रोहयेमम्॥
verses.tr: asya devāḥ pradiśi jyotirastu sūryo agniruta vā hiraṇyam sapatnā asmadadhare bhavantūttamaṃ nākamadhi rohayemam
verses.en: May light, O Gods, be under his dominion, Agni, the Sun, all; that is bright and golden. Prostrate beneath our feet his foes and rivals. Uplift him to the. loftiest cope of heaven.

verses.sa:
येनेन्द्राय समभरः पयांस्युत्तमेन ब्रह्मणा जातवेदः ।
तेन त्वमग्न इह वर्धयेमं सजातानां श्रैष्ठ्य आ धेह्येनम्॥
verses.tr: yenendrāya samabharaḥ payāṃsyuttamena brahmaṇā jātavedaḥ tena tvamagna iha vardhayemaṃ sajātānāṃ śraiṣṭhya ā dhehyenam
verses.en: Through that most mighty prayer, O Jatavedas, wherewith thou. broughtest milk to strengthen Indra, Even therewith exalt this man, O Agni, and give him highest rank among his kinsmen.

verses.sa:
ऐषां यज्ञमुत वर्चो ददेऽहं रायस्पोषमुत चित्तान्यग्ने ।
सपत्ना अस्मदधरे भवन्तूत्तमं नाकमधि रोहयेमम्॥
verses.tr: aiṣāṃ yajñamuta varco dade'haṃ rāyaspoṣamuta cittānyagne sapatnā asmadadhare bhavantūttamaṃ nākamadhi rohayemam
verses.en: I have assumed their sacrifice, O Agni, their hopes, their glory, and their riches' fulness. Prostrate beneath our feet his foes and rivals. Uplift him to the loftiest cope of heaven.

sections.label: Absolution of a sinner after intercession with Varuna
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 10

verses.sa:
अयं देवानामसुरो वि राजति वशा हि सत्या वरुणस्य राज्ञः ।
ततस्परि ब्रह्मणा शाशदान उग्रस्य मन्योरुदिमं नयामि॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ devānāmasuro vi rājati vaśā hi satyā varuṇasya rājñaḥ tataspari brahmaṇā śāśadāna ugrasya manyorudimaṃ nayāmi
verses.en: This Lord is the Gods' ruler; for the wishes of Varuna the King must be accomplished. Therefore, triumphant with the prayer I utter, I rescue this man from the Fierce One's anger.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते राजन् वरुणास्तु मन्यवे विश्वं ह्युऽग्र निचिकेषि द्रुग्धम् ।
सहस्रमन्यान् प्र सुवामि साकं शतं जीवाति शरदस्तवायम्॥
verses.tr: namaste rājan varuṇāstu manyave viśvaṃ hyu'gra nicikeṣi drugdham sahasramanyān pra suvāmi sākaṃ śataṃ jīvāti śaradastavāyam
verses.en: Homage be paid, King Varuna, to thine anger; for thou, dread God, detectest every falsehood. I send a thousand others forth together: let this thy servant live a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
यदुवक्थानृतं जिह्वया वृजिनं बहु।
राज्ञस्त्वा सत्यधर्मणो मुञ्चामि वरुणादहम्॥
verses.tr: yaduvakthānṛtaṃ jihvayā vṛjinaṃ bahu rājñastvā satyadharmaṇo muñcāmi varuṇādaham
verses.en: Whatever falsehood thou hast told, much evil spoken with the tongue, I liberate thee from the noose of Varuna the righteous King.

verses.sa:
मुञ्चामि त्वा वैश्वानरादर्णवान्महतस्परि ।
सजातानुग्रेहा वद ब्रह्म चाप चिकीहि नः॥
verses.tr: muñcāmi tvā vaiśvānarādarṇavānmahataspari sajātānugrehā vada brahma cāpa cikīhi naḥ
verses.en: I free thee from Vaisvanara, from the great surging flood of sin. Call thou thy brothers, Awful One! and pay attention to our prayer.

sections.label: A charm to be used at child-birth
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 11

verses.sa:
वषट् ते पूषन्नस्मिन्त्सूतावर्यमा होता कृणोतु वेधाः ।
सिस्रतां नार्यृतप्रजाता वि पर्वाणि जिहतां सूतवा उ॥
verses.tr: vaṣaṭ te pūṣannasmintsūtāvaryamā hotā kṛṇotu vedhāḥ sisratāṃ nāryṛtaprajātā vi parvāṇi jihatāṃ sūtavā u
verses.en: Vashat to thee, O Pushan! At this birth let Aryaman the Sage perform as Hotar-priest. As one who bears in season let this dame be ready to bring forth her child.

verses.sa:
चतस्रो दिवः प्रदिशश्चतस्रो भूम्या उत।
देवा गर्भं समैरयन् तं व्यूर्णुवन्तु सूतवे॥
verses.tr: catasro divaḥ pradiśaścatasro bhūmyā uta devā garbhaṃ samairayan taṃ vyūrṇuvantu sūtave
verses.en: Four are the regions of the sky, and four the regions of the earth: The Gods have brought the babe; let them prepare the woman for the birth.

verses.sa:
सूषा व्यूर्णोतु वि योनिं हापयामसि ।
श्रथया सूषणे त्वमव त्वं बिष्कले सृज॥
नेव मांसे न पीवसि नेव मज्जस्वाहतम्।
अवैतु पृश्नि शेवलं शुने जराय्वत्तवेऽव जरायु पद्यताम्॥
वि ते भिनद्मि मेहनं वि योनिं वि गवीनिके ।
वि मातरं च पुत्रं च वि कुमारं जरायुणाव जरायु पद्यताम्॥
यथा वातो यथा मनो यथा पतन्ति पक्षिणः ।
एवा त्वं दशमास्य साकं जरायुणा पताव जरायु पद्यताम्॥
verses.tr: sūṣā vyūrṇotu vi yoniṃ hāpayāmasi śrathayā sūṣaṇe tvamava tvaṃ biṣkale sṛja neva māṃse na pīvasi neva majjasvāhatam avaitu pṛśni śevalaṃ śune jarāyvattave'va jarāyu padyatām vi te bhinadmi mehanaṃ vi yoniṃ vi gavīnike vi mātaraṃ ca putraṃ ca vi kumāraṃ jarāyuṇāva jarāyu padyatām yathā vāto yathā mano yathā patanti pakṣiṇaḥ evā tvaṃ daśamāsya sākaṃ jarāyuṇā patāva jarāyu padyatām
verses.en: [Griffith gives stanzas 3-6 only in a Latin version, in the Appendix to his translation: 'The details given in stanzas 3-6 are strictly obstetric and not presentable in English.']

sections.label: A prayer to Lightning, against fever, headache, and cough
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 12

verses.sa:
जरायुजः प्रथम उस्रियो वृषा वातभ्रजा स्तनयन्नेति वृष्ट्या।
स नो मृडाति तन्व ऋजुगो रुजन् य एकमोजस्त्रेधा विचक्रमे॥
verses.tr: jarāyujaḥ prathama usriyo vṛṣā vātabhrajā stanayanneti vṛṣṭyā sa no mṛḍāti tanva ṛjugo rujan ya ekamojastredhā vicakrame
verses.en: Born from the womb, brought forth from wind and from the cloud, the first red bull comes onward thundering with the rain. Our bodies may he spare who, cleaving, goes straight on; he who, a single force, divides himself in three.

verses.sa:
अङ्गे अङ्गे शोचिषा शिश्रियाणं नमस्यन्तस्त्वा हविषा विधेम ।
अङ्कान्त्समङ्कान् हविषा विधेम यो अग्रभीत् पर्वास्या ग्रभीता॥
verses.tr: aṅge aṅge śociṣā śiśriyāṇaṃ namasyantastvā haviṣā vidhema aṅkāntsamaṅkān haviṣā vidhema yo agrabhīt parvāsyā grabhītā
verses.en: Bending to thee who clingest to each limb with heat, fain would we worship thee with offered sacrifice, Worship with sacrifice the bends and curves of thee who with a vigorous grasp hast seized on this one's limbs.

verses.sa:
मुञ्च शीर्षक्त्या उत कास एनं परुष्परुराविवेशा यो अस्य ।
यो अभ्रजा वातजा यश्च शुष्मो वनस्पतीन्त्सचतां पर्वतांश्च॥
verses.tr: muñca śīrṣaktyā uta kāsa enaṃ paruṣparurāviveśā yo asya yo abhrajā vātajā yaśca śuṣmo vanaspatīntsacatāṃ parvatāṃśca
verses.en: Do thou release this man from headache, free him from cough which has entered into all his limbs and joints. May he, the child of cloud, the offspring of the wind, the whizzing lightning, strike the mountains and the trees.

verses.sa:
शं मे परस्मै गात्राय शमस्त्ववराय मे ।
शं मे चतुर्भ्यो अङ्गेभ्यः शमस्तु तन्वे३मम॥
verses.tr: śaṃ me parasmai gātrāya śamastvavarāya me śaṃ me caturbhyo aṅgebhyaḥ śamastu tanve3mama
verses.en: Well be it with my upper frame, well be it with my lower parts. With my four limbs let it be well. Let all my body be in health.

sections.label: A prayer to Lightning, for happiness
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 13

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अस्तु विद्युते नमस्ते स्तनयित्नवे ।
नमस्ते अस्त्वश्मने येना दूडाशे अस्यसि॥
verses.tr: namaste astu vidyute namaste stanayitnave namaste astvaśmane yenā dūḍāśe asyasi
verses.en: Homage to thee, the Lightning's flash, homage to thee, the Thunder's roar! Homage to thee, the Stone which thou hurlest against the undevout!

verses.sa:
नमस्ते प्रवतो नपाद्यतस्तपः समूहसि ।
मृडया नस्तनूभ्यो मयस्तोकेभ्यस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: namaste pravato napādyatastapaḥ samūhasi mṛḍayā nastanūbhyo mayastokebhyaskṛdhi
verses.en: Homage to thee, Child of the Flood whence thou collectest fervent heat! Be gracious to our bodies, give our children happiness and joy.

verses.sa:
प्रवतो नपान्नम एवास्तु तुभ्यं नमस्ते हेतये तपुषे च कृण्मः ।
विद्म ते धाम परमं गुहा यत् समुद्रे अन्तर्निहितासि नाभिः॥
verses.tr: pravato napānnama evāstu tubhyaṃ namaste hetaye tapuṣe ca kṛṇmaḥ vidma te dhāma paramaṃ guhā yat samudre antarnihitāsi nābhiḥ
verses.en: Yea, homage be to thee, O Offspring of the Flood! Homage we pay to thee, the dart and fiery flame: For well we know thy secret and sublimest home, where thou as central point art buried in the sea.

verses.sa:
यां त्वा देवा असृजन्त विश्व इषुं कृण्वाना असनाय धृष्णुम्।
सा नो मृड विदथे गृणाना तस्यै ते नमो अस्तु देवि॥
verses.tr: yāṃ tvā devā asṛjanta viśva iṣuṃ kṛṇvānā asanāya dhṛṣṇum sā no mṛḍa vidathe gṛṇānā tasyai te namo astu devi
verses.en: Thou, Arrow, which the host of Gods created, making it strong and mighty for the shooting, Be gracious, lauded thus, to our assembly. To thee, that Arrow, be our homage, Goddess!

sections.label: A woman's incantation against a rival
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 14

verses.sa:
भगमस्या वर्च आदिष्यधि वृक्षादिव स्रजम्।
महाबुध्न इव पर्वतो ज्योक् पितृष्वास्ताम्॥
verses.tr: bhagamasyā varca ādiṣyadhi vṛkṣādiva srajam mahābudhna iva parvato jyok pitṛṣvāstām
verses.en: As from the tree a wreath, have I assumed her fortune and her fame: Among her kinsfolk long may she dwell, like a mountain broadly-based.

verses.sa:
एषा ते राजन् कन्या वधूर्नि धूयतां यम ।
सा मातुर्बध्यतां गृहेऽथो भ्रातुरथो पितुः॥
verses.tr: eṣā te rājan kanyā vadhūrni dhūyatāṃ yama sā māturbadhyatāṃ gṛhe'tho bhrāturatho pituḥ
verses.en: King Yama, let this maiden be surrendered as a wife to thee: Bound let her be meanwhile within her mother's, brother's, father's house.

verses.sa:
एषा ते कुलपा राजन् तामु ते परि दद्मसि ।
ज्योक् पितृष्वासाता आ शीर्ष्णः समोप्यात्॥
verses.tr: eṣā te kulapā rājan tāmu te pari dadmasi jyok pitṛṣvāsātā ā śīrṣṇaḥ samopyāt
verses.en: Queen of thy race is she, O King: to thee do we deliver her. Long with her kinsfolk may she sit, until her hair be white with age.

verses.sa:
असितस्य ते ब्रह्मणा कश्यपस्य गयस्य च ।
अन्तःकोशमिव जामयोऽपि नह्यामि ते भगम्॥
verses.tr: asitasya te brahmaṇā kaśyapasya gayasya ca antaḥkośamiva jāmayo'pi nahyāmi te bhagam
verses.en: With Asita's and Kasyapa's and Gaya's incantation, thus As sisters pack within a chest, I bind and tie thy fortune up.

sections.label: A prayer for the prosperity of an institutor of sacrifice
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 15

verses.sa:
सं सं स्रवन्तु सिन्धवः सं वाताः सं पतत्रिणः ।
इमं यज्ञं प्रदिवो मे जुषन्तां संस्राव्येण हविषा जुहोमि॥
verses.tr: saṃ saṃ sravantu sindhavaḥ saṃ vātāḥ saṃ patatriṇaḥ imaṃ yajñaṃ pradivo me juṣantāṃ saṃsrāvyeṇa haviṣā juhomi
verses.en: Let the streams flow together, let the winds and birds assembled come. Let this my sacrifice delight them always. I offer it with duly mixt oblation.

verses.sa:
इहैव हवमा यात म इह संस्रावणा उतेमं वर्धयता गिरः ।
इहैतु सर्वो यः पशुरस्मिन् तिष्ठतु या रयिः॥
verses.tr: ihaiva havamā yāta ma iha saṃsrāvaṇā utemaṃ vardhayatā giraḥ ihaitu sarvo yaḥ paśurasmin tiṣṭhatu yā rayiḥ
verses.en: Come to my call, Blent Offerings, come ye very nigh. And, singers, do ye strengthen and increase this man. Hither come every animal: with this man let all wealth abide.

verses.sa:
ये नदीनां संस्रवन्त्युत्सासः सदमक्षिताः ।
तेभिर्मे सर्वैः संस्रावैर्धनं सं स्रावयामसि॥
verses.tr: ye nadīnāṃ saṃsravantyutsāsaḥ sadamakṣitāḥ tebhirme sarvaiḥ saṃsrāvairdhanaṃ saṃ srāvayāmasi
verses.en: All river founts that blend their streams for ever inexhaustible—With all these confluent streams of mine we make abundant riches flow.

verses.sa:
ये सर्पिषः संस्रवन्ति क्षीरस्य चोदकस्य च ।
तेभिर्मे सर्वैः संस्रावैर्धनं सं स्रावयामसि॥
verses.tr: ye sarpiṣaḥ saṃsravanti kṣīrasya codakasya ca tebhirme sarvaiḥ saṃsrāvairdhanaṃ saṃ srāvayāmasi
verses.en: All streams of melted butter, and all streams of water and of milk With all these confluent streams of mine we make abundant riches flow.

sections.label: A prayer and charm against demons
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 16

verses.sa:
येऽमावास्यां३ रात्रिमुदस्थुर्व्राजमत्त्रिणः ।
अग्निस्तुरीयो यातुहा सो अस्मभ्यमधि ब्रवत्॥
verses.tr: ye'māvāsyāṃ3 rātrimudasthurvrājamattriṇaḥ agnisturīyo yātuhā so asmabhyamadhi bravat
verses.en: May potent Agni who destroys the demons bless and shelter us. From greedy fiends who rise up in troops at night-time when the moon is dark.

verses.sa:
सीसायाध्याह वरुणः सीसायाग्निरुपावति ।
सीसं म इन्द्रः प्रायच्छत् तदङ्ग यातुचातनम्॥
verses.tr: sīsāyādhyāha varuṇaḥ sīsāyāgnirupāvati sīsaṃ ma indraḥ prāyacchat tadaṅga yātucātanam
verses.en: Varuna's benison hath blessed the lead, and Agni strengthens it. Indra hath given me the lead: this verily repels the fiends.

verses.sa:
इदं विष्कन्धं सहत इदं बाधते अत्त्रिणः ।
अनेन विश्वा ससहे या जातानि पिशाच्याः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ viṣkandhaṃ sahata idaṃ bādhate attriṇaḥ anena viśvā sasahe yā jātāni piśācyāḥ
verses.en: This overcomes Vishkandha, this drives the voracious fiends away: By means of this have I overthrown all the Pisachi's demon brood.

verses.sa:
यदि नो गां हंसि यद्यश्वं यदि पूरुषम्।
तं त्वा सीसेन विध्यामो यथा नोऽसो अवीरहा॥
verses.tr: yadi no gāṃ haṃsi yadyaśvaṃ yadi pūruṣam taṃ tvā sīsena vidhyāmo yathā no'so avīrahā
verses.en: If thou destroy a cow of ours, a human being, or a steed, We pierce thee with this piece of lead so that thou mayst not slay our men.

sections.label: A charm to be employed when venesection is performed
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 17

verses.sa:
अमूर्या यन्ति योषितो हिरा लोहितवाससः ।
अभ्रातर इव जामयस्तिष्ठन्तु हतवर्चसः॥
verses.tr: amūryā yanti yoṣito hirā lohitavāsasaḥ abhrātara iva jāmayastiṣṭhantu hatavarcasaḥ
verses.en: Those maidens there, the veins, who run their course in robes of ruddy hue, Must now stand quiet, reft of power, like sisters who are brotherless.

verses.sa:
तिष्ठावरे तिष्ठ पर उत त्वं तिष्ठ मध्यमे ।
कनिष्ठिका च तिष्ठति तिष्ठादिद्धमनिर्मही॥
verses.tr: tiṣṭhāvare tiṣṭha para uta tvaṃ tiṣṭha madhyame kaniṣṭhikā ca tiṣṭhati tiṣṭhādiddhamanirmahī
verses.en: Stay still, thou upper vein, stay still, thou lower, stay, thou midmost one, The smallest one of all stands still: let the great vessel even be still.

verses.sa:
शतस्य धमनीनां सहस्रस्य हिराणाम्।
अस्थुरिन्मध्यमा इमाः साकमन्ता अरंसत॥
verses.tr: śatasya dhamanīnāṃ sahasrasya hirāṇām asthurinmadhyamā imāḥ sākamantā araṃsata
verses.en: Among a thousand vessels charged with blood, among a thousand veins, Even these the middlemost stand still and the extremities have rest.

verses.sa: परि वः सिकतावती धनूर्बृहत्यऽक्रमीत्।तिष्ठतेलयता सु कम्॥
verses.tr: pari vaḥ sikatāvatī dhanūrbṛhatya'kramīttiṣṭhatelayatā su kam
verses.en: A mighty rampart built of sand hath circled and encompassed you: Be still, and quietly take rest.

sections.label: A charm to avert evil spirits of misfortune and to secure prosperity
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 18

verses.sa:
निर्लक्ष्म्यं ऽ ललाम्यं१ निररातिं सुवामसि ।
अथ या भद्रा तानि नः प्रजाया अरातिं नयामसि॥
verses.tr: nirlakṣmyaṃ ' lalāmyaṃ1 nirarātiṃ suvāmasi atha yā bhadrā tāni naḥ prajāyā arātiṃ nayāmasi
verses.en: We drive away the Spotted Hag, Misfortune, and Malignity: All blessings to our children then! We chase Malignity away.

verses.sa:
निररणिं सविता साविषक् पदोर्निर्हस्तयोर्वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा।
निरस्मभ्यमनुमती रराणा प्रेमां देवा असाविषुः सौभगाय॥
verses.tr: niraraṇiṃ savitā sāviṣak padornirhastayorvaruṇo mitro aryamā nirasmabhyamanumatī rarāṇā premāṃ devā asāviṣuḥ saubhagāya
verses.en: Let Savitar, Mitra, Varuna, and Aryaman drive away Stinginess from both the hands and feet: May Favour, granting us her bounties, drive her off. The Gods created Favour for our happiness.

verses.sa:
यत् त आत्मनि तन्वां ऽ घोरमस्ति यद्वा केशेषु प्रतिचक्षणे वा ।
सर्वं तद्वाचाप हन्मो वयं देवस्त्वा सविता सूदयतु॥
verses.tr: yat ta ātmani tanvāṃ ' ghoramasti yadvā keśeṣu praticakṣaṇe vā sarvaṃ tadvācāpa hanmo vayaṃ devastvā savitā sūdayatu
verses.en: Each fearful sign upon thy body, in thyself, each inauspicious mark seen in thy hair, thy face, All this we drive away and banish with our speech. May Savitar the God graciously further thee.

verses.sa:
रिश्यपदीं वृषदतीं गोषेधां विधमामुत।
विलीढ्यं ऽ ललाम्यं१ ता अस्मन्नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: riśyapadīṃ vṛṣadatīṃ goṣedhāṃ vidhamāmuta vilīḍhyaṃ ' lalāmyaṃ1 tā asmannāśayāmasi
verses.en: Antelope-foot, and Bullock-tooth, Cow-terrifier, Vapour-form, The Licker, and the Spotted Hag, all these we drive away from us.

sections.label: A prayer for protection from arrows and for 'the punishment of enemies
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 19

verses.sa:
मा नो विदन् विव्याधिनो मो अभिव्याधिनो विदन्।
आराच्छरव्या ऽ अस्मद्विषूचीरिन्द्र पातय॥
verses.tr: mā no vidan vivyādhino mo abhivyādhino vidan ārāccharavyā ' asmadviṣūcīrindra pātaya
verses.en: Let not the piercers find us, nor let those who wound discover us. O Indra, make the arrows fall, turned. far from us, to every side.

verses.sa:
विष्वञ्चो अस्मच्छरवः पतन्तु ये अस्ता ये चास्याः ।
दैवीर्मनुष्येषवो ममामित्रान् वि विध्यत॥
verses.tr: viṣvañco asmaccharavaḥ patantu ye astā ye cāsyāḥ daivīrmanuṣyeṣavo mamāmitrān vi vidhyata
verses.en: Turned from us let the arrows fall, those shot and those that will be shot. Shafts of the Gods and shafts of men, strike and transfix mine enemies!

verses.sa:
यो नः स्वो यो अरणः सजात उत निष्ट्यो यो अस्माँ अभिदासति ।
रुद्रः शरव्य ऽ यैतान् ममामित्रान् वि विध्यतु॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ svo yo araṇaḥ sajāta uta niṣṭyo yo asmāṃ abhidāsati rudraḥ śaravya ' yaitān mamāmitrān vi vidhyatu
verses.en: Whoever treateth us as foes, be he our own or strange to us, a kinsman or a foreigner, May Rudra with his arrows pierce and slay these enemies of mine.

verses.sa:
यः सपत्नो योऽसपत्नो यश्च द्विषन् छपाति नः ।
देवास्तं सर्वे धूर्वन्तु ब्रह्म वर्म ममान्तरम्॥
verses.tr: yaḥ sapatno yo'sapatno yaśca dviṣan chapāti naḥ devāstaṃ sarve dhūrvantu brahma varma mamāntaram
verses.en: The rival and non-rival, he who in his hatred curses May all the deities injure him! My nearest, closest mail is prayer.

sections.label: A prayer to Soma, the Maruts, Mitra, and Varuna, for protection
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 20

verses.sa:
अदारसृद् भवतु देव सोमास्मिन् यज्ञे मरुतो मृडता नः ।
मा नो विददभिभा मो अशस्तिर्मा नो विदद् वृजिना द्वेष्या या॥
verses.tr: adārasṛd bhavatu deva somāsmin yajñe maruto mṛḍatā naḥ mā no vidadabhibhā mo aśastirmā no vidad vṛjinā dveṣyā yā
verses.en: May it glide harmless by in this our sacrifice, O Soma, God! Maruts, be gracious unto us. Let not disaster, let not malison find us out; let not abominable guiles discover us.

verses.sa:
यो अद्य सेन्यो वधोऽघायूनामुदीरते ।
युवं तं मित्रावरुणावस्मद्यावयतं परि॥
verses.tr: yo adya senyo vadho'ghāyūnāmudīrate yuvaṃ taṃ mitrāvaruṇāvasmadyāvayataṃ pari
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna, ye twain, turn carefully away from us The deadly dart that flies to-day, the missile of the wicked ones.

verses.sa:
इतश्च यदमुतश्च यद् वधं वरुण यावय ।
वि महच्छर्म यच्छ वरीयो यावया वधम्॥
verses.tr: itaśca yadamutaśca yad vadhaṃ varuṇa yāvaya vi mahaccharma yaccha varīyo yāvayā vadham
verses.en: Ward off from this side and from that, O Varnna, the deadly dart: Give us thy great protection, turn the lethal weapon far away.

verses.sa:
शास इत्था महाँ अस्यमित्रसाहो अस्तृतः ।
न यस्य हन्यते सखा न जीयते कदा चन॥
verses.tr: śāsa itthā mahāṃ asyamitrasāho astṛtaḥ na yasya hanyate sakhā na jīyate kadā cana
verses.en: A mighty Ruler thus art thou, unconquered, vanquisher of foes, Even thou whose friend is never slain, whose friend is never overcome.

sections.label: A prayer to Indra for protection
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 21

verses.sa:
स्वस्तिदा विशां पतिर्वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी।
वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नः सोमपा अभयंकरः॥
verses.tr: svastidā viśāṃ patirvṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ somapā abhayaṃkaraḥ
verses.en: Lord of the clans, giver of bliss, fiend-slayer, mighty o'er the foe, May Indra, Soma-drinker, go before us, Bull, who brings us peace.

verses.sa:
वि न इन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः ।
अधमं गमया तमो यो अस्माँ अभिदासति॥
verses.tr: vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ adhamaṃ gamayā tamo yo asmāṃ abhidāsati
verses.en: Indra, subdue our enemies, lay low the men who fight with us: Down into nether darkness send the man who shows us enmity:

verses.sa:
वि रक्षो वि मृधो जहि वि वृत्रस्य हनू रुज ।
वि मन्युमिन्द्र वृत्रहन्नमित्रस्याभिदासतः॥
verses.tr: vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja vi manyumindra vṛtrahannamitrasyābhidāsataḥ
verses.en: Strike down the fiend, strike down the foes, break thou asunder Vritra's jaws. O Indra, Vritra-slayer, quell the wrath of the assail-. ing foe.

verses.sa:
अपेन्द्र द्विषतो मनोऽप जिज्यासतो वधम्।
वि महच्छर्म यच्छ वरीयो यावया वधम्॥
verses.tr: apendra dviṣato mano'pa jijyāsato vadham vi mahaccharma yaccha varīyo yāvayā vadham
verses.en: Turn thou the foeman's thought away, his dart who fain would conquer us: Grant us thy great protection; keep his deadly weapon far away.

sections.label: A charm against jaundice
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 22

verses.sa:
अनु सूर्यमुदयतां हृद्दयोतो हरिमा च ते ।
गो रोहितस्य वर्णेन तेन त्वा परि दध्मसि॥
verses.tr: anu sūryamudayatāṃ hṛddayoto harimā ca te go rohitasya varṇena tena tvā pari dadhmasi
verses.en: As the Sun rises let thy sore disease and yellowness depart. We compass and surround thee with the colour of a ruddy ox.

verses.sa:
परि त्वा रोहितैर्वर्णैर्दीर्घायुत्वाय दध्मसि ।
यथायमरपा असदथो अहरितो भुवत्॥
verses.tr: pari tvā rohitairvarṇairdīrghāyutvāya dadhmasi yathāyamarapā asadatho aharito bhuvat
verses.en: With ruddy hues we compass thee that thou mayst live a lengthened life: So that this man be free from harm, and cast his yellow tint away.

verses.sa:
या रोहिणीर्देवत्या३ गावो या उत रोहिणीः ।
रूपंरूपं वयोवयस्ताभिष्ट्वा परि दध्मसि॥
verses.tr: yā rohiṇīrdevatyā3 gāvo yā uta rohiṇīḥ rūpaṃrūpaṃ vayovayastābhiṣṭvā pari dadhmasi
verses.en: Devatyas that are red of hue, yea, and the ruddy-coloured kine, Each several form, each several age,—with these we compass thee about.

verses.sa:
शुकेषु ते हरिमाणं रोपणाकासु दध्मसि ।
अथो हारिद्रवेषु ते हरिमाणं नि दध्मसि॥
verses.tr: śukeṣu te harimāṇaṃ ropaṇākāsu dadhmasi atho hāridraveṣu te harimāṇaṃ ni dadhmasi
verses.en: To parrots and to starlings we transfer thy sickly yellowness: Now in the yellow-coloured birds we lay this yellowness of thine.

sections.label: A charm against leprosy
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 23

verses.sa:
नक्तंजातास्योषधे रामे कृष्णे असिक्नि च ।
इदं रजनि रजय किलासं पलितं च यत्॥
verses.tr: naktaṃjātāsyoṣadhe rāme kṛṣṇe asikni ca idaṃ rajani rajaya kilāsaṃ palitaṃ ca yat
verses.en: O Plant, thou sprangest up at night, dusky dark coloured, black in hue! So, Rajani, re-colour thou these ashy spots, this-leprosy.

verses.sa:
किलासं च पलितं च निरितो नाशया पृषत्।
आ त्वा स्वो विशतां वर्णः परा शुक्लानि पातय॥
verses.tr: kilāsaṃ ca palitaṃ ca nirito nāśayā pṛṣat ā tvā svo viśatāṃ varṇaḥ parā śuklāni pātaya
verses.en: Expel the leprosy, remove from him the spots and ashy hue: Let thine own colour come to thee; drive far away the specks of white.

verses.sa:
असितं ते प्रलयनमास्थानमसितं तव ।
असिक्न्यस्योषधे निरितो नाशया पृषत्॥
verses.tr: asitaṃ te pralayanamāsthānamasitaṃ tava asiknyasyoṣadhe nirito nāśayā pṛṣat
verses.en: Dark is the place of thy repose, dark is the place thou dwellest in: Dusky and dark, O Plant, art thou: remove from him each speck and spot.

verses.sa:
अस्थिजस्य किलासस्य तनूजस्य च यत् त्वचि।
दूष्या कृतस्य ब्रह्मणा लक्ष्म श्वेतमनीनशम्॥
verses.tr: asthijasya kilāsasya tanūjasya ca yat tvaci dūṣyā kṛtasya brahmaṇā lakṣma śvetamanīnaśam
verses.en: I with my spell have chased away the pallid sign of leprosy. Caused by infection, on the skin, sprung from the body, from the bones.

sections.label: A charm against leprosy
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 24

verses.sa:
सुपर्णो जातः प्रथमस्तस्य त्वं पित्तमासिथ ।
तदासुरी युधा जिता रूपं चक्रे वनस्पतीन्॥
verses.tr: suparṇo jātaḥ prathamastasya tvaṃ pittamāsitha tadāsurī yudhā jitā rūpaṃ cakre vanaspatīn
verses.en: First, before all, the strong-winged Bird was born; thou wast the gall thereof. Conquered in fight, the Asuri took then the shape and form of plants.

verses.sa:
आसुरी चक्रे प्रथमेदं किलासभेषजमिदं किलासनाशनम्।
अनीनशत् किलासं सरूपामकरत् त्वचम्॥
verses.tr: āsurī cakre prathamedaṃ kilāsabheṣajamidaṃ kilāsanāśanam anīnaśat kilāsaṃ sarūpāmakarat tvacam
verses.en: The Asura made, first of all, this medicine for leprosy, this banisher of leprosy. She banished of leprosy, and gave one general colour to the skin.

verses.sa:
सरूपा नाम ते माता सरूपो नाम ते पिता।
सरूपकृत् त्वमोषधे सा सरूपमिदं कृधि॥
verses.tr: sarūpā nāma te mātā sarūpo nāma te pitā sarūpakṛt tvamoṣadhe sā sarūpamidaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: One-coloured, is thy mother's name, One-coloured is thy father called: One-colour-maker, Plant! art thou: give thou one colour to this man. f

verses.sa:
श्यामा सरूपंकरणी पृथिव्या अध्युद्भृता ।
इदमू षु प्र साधय पुना रूपाणि कल्पय॥
verses.tr: śyāmā sarūpaṃkaraṇī pṛthivyā adhyudbhṛtā idamū ṣu pra sādhaya punā rūpāṇi kalpaya
verses.en: Sama who gives one general hue was formed and fashioned from the earth: Further this work efficiently. Restore the colours that were his.

sections.label: A prayer to Fever, as a charm against his attacks
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 25

verses.sa:
यदग्निरापो अदहत् प्रविश्य यत्राकृण्वन् धर्मधृतो नमांसि ।
तत्र त आहुः परमं जनित्रं स नः संविद्वान् परि वृङ्ग्धि तक्मन्॥
verses.tr: yadagnirāpo adahat praviśya yatrākṛṇvan dharmadhṛto namāṃsi tatra ta āhuḥ paramaṃ janitraṃ sa naḥ saṃvidvān pari vṛṅgdhi takman
verses.en: When Agni blazed when he had pierced the Waters, whereat the Law-observers paid him homage, There, men assever, was thy loftiest birthplace: O Fever, yielding to our prayer avoid us.

verses.sa:
यद्यर्चिर्यदि वासि शोचिः शकल्येषि यदि वा ते जनित्रम्।
ह्रूडुर्नामासि हरितस्य देव स नः संविद्वान् परि वृङ्ग्धि तक्मन्॥
verses.tr: yadyarciryadi vāsi śociḥ śakalyeṣi yadi vā te janitram hrūḍurnāmāsi haritasya deva sa naḥ saṃvidvān pari vṛṅgdhi takman
verses.en: If thou be fiery glow, or inflammation, or if thy birthplace call for chips of fuel, Rack is thy name, God of the sickly yellow! f O Fever, yielding to our prayer avoid us.

verses.sa:
यदि शोको यदि वाभिशोको यदि वा राज्ञो वरुणस्यासि पुत्रः ।
ह्रूडुर्नामासि हरितस्य देव स नः संविद्वान् परि वृङ्ग्धि तक्मन्॥
verses.tr: yadi śoko yadi vābhiśoko yadi vā rājño varuṇasyāsi putraḥ hrūḍurnāmāsi haritasya deva sa naḥ saṃvidvān pari vṛṅgdhi takman
verses.en: Be thou distress, or agonizing torment, be thou the son King Varuna hath begotten, Rack is thy name, God of the sickly yellow! O Fever, yielding to our prayer avoid us.

verses.sa:
नमः शीताय तक्मने नमो रूराय शोचिषे कृणोमि ।
यो अन्येद्युरुभयद्युरभ्येति तृतीयकाय नमो अस्तु तक्मने॥
verses.tr: namaḥ śītāya takmane namo rūrāya śociṣe kṛṇomi yo anyedyurubhayadyurabhyeti tṛtīyakāya namo astu takmane
verses.en: I offer homage to the chilly Fever, to his fierce burning glow I offer homage. Be adoration paid to Fever coming each other day, the third, or two days running.

sections.label: A prayer for protection, guidance, and prosperity
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 26

verses.sa: आरे३सावस्मदस्तु हेतिर्देवासो असत्। आरे अश्मा यमस्यथ॥
verses.tr: āre3sāvasmadastu hetirdevāso asat āre aśmā yamasyatha
verses.en: Let that Destructive Weapon be far distant from us, O ye Gods; far be the Stone ye wont to hurl.

verses.sa: सखासावस्मभ्यमस्तु रातिः सखेन्द्रो भगः सविता चित्रराधाः॥
verses.tr: sakhāsāvasmabhyamastu rātiḥ sakhendro bhagaḥ savitā citrarādhāḥ
verses.en: Our friend be that Celestial Grace, Indra and Bhaga be our friends, and Savitar with splendid wealth.

verses.sa: यूयं नः प्रवतो नपान्मरुतः सूर्यत्वचसः । शर्म यच्छाथ सप्रथाः॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ naḥ pravato napānmarutaḥ sūryatvacasaḥ śarma yacchātha saprathāḥ
verses.en: Thou, Offspring of the Waterflood, ye Maruts, with your sun-bright skins, give us protection reaching far.

verses.sa: सुषूदत मृडत मृडया नस्तनूभ्यो मयस्तोकेभ्यस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: suṣūdata mṛḍata mṛḍayā nastanūbhyo mayastokebhyaskṛdhi
verses.en: Further us rightly, favour ye our bodies with your gracious love. Give thou our children happiness.

sections.label: A charm to obtain invisibility
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 27

verses.sa:
अमूः पारे पृदाक्व ऽ स्त्रिषप्ता निर्जरायवः ।
तासां जरायुभिर्वयमक्ष्यावपि व्ययामस्यघायोः परिपन्थिनः॥
verses.tr: amūḥ pāre pṛdākva ' striṣaptā nirjarāyavaḥ tāsāṃ jarāyubhirvayamakṣyāvapi vyayāmasyaghāyoḥ paripanthinaḥ
verses.en: There on the bank those Vipers lie, thrice-seven, having cast their skins: Now we with their discarded sloughs bind close and cover up the eyes of the malicious highway thief.

verses.sa:
विषूच्येतु कृन्तती पिनाकमिव बिभ्रती ।
विष्वक् पुनर्भुवा मनोऽसमृद्धा अघायवः॥
verses.tr: viṣūcyetu kṛntatī pinākamiva bibhratī viṣvak punarbhuvā mano'samṛddhā aghāyavaḥ
verses.en: Far let her go, cutting her way, brandishing, as it were, a club: Diverted be the new-born's mind: ne'er are the wicked prosperous.

verses.sa:
न बहवः समशकन् नार्भका अभि दाधृषुः ।
वेणोरद्गा इवाभितोऽसमृद्धा अघायवः॥
verses.tr: na bahavaḥ samaśakan nārbhakā abhi dādhṛṣuḥ veṇoradgā ivābhito'samṛddhā aghāyavaḥ
verses.en: Not many have had power enough; the feeble ones have not prevailed, Like scattered fragments of a reed: ne'er are the wicked prosperous.

verses.sa:
प्रेतं पादौ प्र स्फुरतं वहतं पृणतो गृहान्।
इन्द्राण्येऽतु प्रथमाजीतामुषिता पुरः॥
verses.tr: pretaṃ pādau pra sphurataṃ vahataṃ pṛṇato gṛhān indrāṇye'tu prathamājītāmuṣitā puraḥ
verses.en: Go forward, feet, press quickly on, bring to the house of him who pays. Unconquered and unplundered, let Indrani, foremost, lead the way.

sections.label: A prayer to Agni for the destruction of evil spirits
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 28

verses.sa:
उप प्रागाद् देवो अग्नी रक्षोहामीवचातनः ।
दहन्नप द्वयाविनो यातुधानान् किमीदिनः॥
verses.tr: upa prāgād devo agnī rakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ dahannapa dvayāvino yātudhānān kimīdinaḥ
verses.en: God Agni hath come forth to us, fiend-slayer, chaser of disease, Burning the Yatudhanas up, Kimidins, and deceitful ones.

verses.sa:
प्रति दह यातुधानान् प्रति देव किमीदिनः ।
प्रतीचीः कृष्णवर्तने सं दह यातुधान्यः॥
verses.tr: prati daha yātudhānān prati deva kimīdinaḥ pratīcīḥ kṛṣṇavartane saṃ daha yātudhānyaḥ
verses.en: Consume the Yatudhanas, God! meet the Kimidins with thy flame: Burn up the Yatudhanis as they face thee, thou whose path is black!

verses.sa:
या शशाप शपनेन याघं मूरमादधे।
या रसस्य हरणाय जातमारेभे तोकमत्तु सा॥
verses.tr: yā śaśāpa śapanena yāghaṃ mūramādadhe yā rasasya haraṇāya jātamārebhe tokamattu sā
verses.en: She who hath cursed us with a curse, or hath conceived a murderous sin; Or seized our son to take his blood, let her devour the child she bare.

verses.sa:
पुत्रमत्तु यातुधानीः स्वसारमुत नप्त्यऽम्।
अधा मिथो विकेश्यो३वि घ्नतां यातुधान्यो३वि तृह्यन्तामराय्यः॥
verses.tr: putramattu yātudhānīḥ svasāramuta naptya'm adhā mitho vikeśyo3vi ghnatāṃ yātudhānyo3vi tṛhyantāmarāyyaḥ
verses.en: Let her, the Yatudhani eat son, sister, and her daughter's child. Now let the twain by turns destroy the wild-haired Yatudhanis and crush down Arayas to the earth!

sections.label: A charm to secure the supremacy of dethroned King
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 29

verses.sa:
अभीवर्तेन मणिना येनेन्द्रो अभिवावृधे।
तेनास्मान् ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽभि राष्ट्राय वर्धय॥
verses.tr: abhīvartena maṇinā yenendro abhivāvṛdhe tenāsmān brahmaṇaspate'bhi rāṣṭrāya vardhaya
verses.en: With that victorious Amulet which strengthened Indra's power and might Do thou, O Brahmanaspati, increase our strength for kingly sway.

verses.sa:
अभिवृत्य सपत्नानभि या नो अरातयः ।
अभि पृतन्यन्तं तिष्ठाभि यो नो दुरस्यति॥
verses.tr: abhivṛtya sapatnānabhi yā no arātayaḥ abhi pṛtanyantaṃ tiṣṭhābhi yo no durasyati
verses.en: Subduing those who rival us, subduing all malignities, Withstand the man who menaces, and him who seeks to injure us.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा देवः सविताभि सोमो अवीवृधत्।
अभि त्वा विश्वा भूतान्यभीवर्तो यथाससि॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā devaḥ savitābhi somo avīvṛdhat abhi tvā viśvā bhūtānyabhīvarto yathāsasi
verses.en: Soma and Savitar the God have strengthened and exalted thee: All elements have aided thee, to make thee general conqueror.

verses.sa:
अभीवर्तो अभिभवः सपत्नक्षयणो मणिः ।
राष्ट्राय मह्यं बध्यतां सपत्नेभ्यः पराभुवे॥
verses.tr: abhīvarto abhibhavaḥ sapatnakṣayaṇo maṇiḥ rāṣṭrāya mahyaṃ badhyatāṃ sapatnebhyaḥ parābhuve
verses.en: Slayer of rivals, vanquisher, may that victorious Amulet Be bound on me for regal sway and conquest of mine enemies.

verses.sa:
उदसौ सूर्यो अगादुदिदं मामकं वचः ।
यथाहं शत्रुहोऽसान्यसपत्नः सपत्नहा॥
verses.tr: udasau sūryo agādudidaṃ māmakaṃ vacaḥ yathāhaṃ śatruho'sānyasapatnaḥ sapatnahā
verses.en: Yon Sun hath mounted up on high, and this my word hath mounted up That I may smite my foes and be slayer of rivals, rivalless.

verses.sa:
सपत्नक्षयणो वृषाभिराष्ट्रो विषासहिः ।
यथाहमेषां वीराणां विराजानि जनस्य च॥
verses.tr: sapatnakṣayaṇo vṛṣābhirāṣṭro viṣāsahiḥ yathāhameṣāṃ vīrāṇāṃ virājāni janasya ca
verses.en: Destroyer of my rivals, strong, victorious, with royal sway, May I be ruler of these men, and King and sovran of the folk.

sections.label: A benediction on a King at his consecration
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 30

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवा वसवो रक्षतेममुतादित्या जागृत यूयमस्मिन्।
मेमं सनाभिरुत वान्यनाभिर्मेमं प्रापत् पौरुषेयो वधो यः॥
verses.tr: viśve devā vasavo rakṣatemamutādityā jāgṛta yūyamasmin memaṃ sanābhiruta vānyanābhirmemaṃ prāpat pauruṣeyo vadho yaḥ
verses.en: Guard and protect this man, all Gods and Vasus. Over him keep ye watch and ward, Adityas. Let not death reach him from the hands of brothers,

verses.sa:
ये वो देवाः पितरो ये च पुत्राः सचेतसो मे शृणुतेदमुक्तम्।
सर्वेभ्यो वः परि ददाम्येतं स्वस्त्येऽनं जरसे वहाथ॥
verses.tr: ye vo devāḥ pitaro ye ca putrāḥ sacetaso me śṛṇutedamuktam sarvebhyo vaḥ pari dadāmyetaṃ svastye'naṃ jarase vahātha
verses.en: Listen, one-minded, to the word I utter, the sons, O Gods, among you, and the fathers! I trust this man to all of you: preserve him happily, and to length of days conduct him.

verses.sa:
ये देवा दिवि ष्ठ ये पृथिव्यां ये अन्तरिक्ष ओषधीषु पशुष्वप्स्व१न्तः ।
ते कृणुत जरसमायुरस्मै शतमन्यान् परि वृणक्तु मृत्यून्॥
verses.tr: ye devā divi ṣṭha ye pṛthivyāṃ ye antarikṣa oṣadhīṣu paśuṣvapsva1ntaḥ te kṛṇuta jarasamāyurasmai śatamanyān pari vṛṇaktu mṛtyūn
verses.en: All Gods who dwell on earth or in the heavens, in air, within the plants, the beasts, the waters, Grant this man life to full old age, and let him escape the hundred other ways of dying.

verses.sa:
येषां प्रयाजा उत वानुयाजा हुतभागा अहुतादश्च देवाः ।
येषां वः पञ्च प्रदिशो विभक्तास्तान् वो अस्मै सत्रसदः कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: yeṣāṃ prayājā uta vānuyājā hutabhāgā ahutādaśca devāḥ yeṣāṃ vaḥ pañca pradiśo vibhaktāstān vo asmai satrasadaḥ kṛṇomi
verses.en: You, claiming Anuyajas or Prayajas, sharers, or not consumers, of oblation, You, to whom heaven's five regions are apportioned, I make companions at his sacred sessions.

sections.label: A prayer for protection and general prosperity
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 31

verses.sa:
आशानामाशापालेभ्यश्चतुर्भ्यो अमृतेभ्यः ।
इदं भूतस्याध्यक्षेभ्यो विधेम हविषा वयम्॥
verses.tr: āśānāmāśāpālebhyaścaturbhyo amṛtebhyaḥ idaṃ bhūtasyādhyakṣebhyo vidhema haviṣā vayam
verses.en: Here will we serve with sacrifice the great Controllers of the world, The four immortal Warders who protect the regions of the sky.

verses.sa:
य आशानामाशापालाश्चत्वार स्थन देवाः ।
ते नो निरृत्याः पाशेभ्यो मुञ्चतांहसो अंहसः॥
verses.tr: ya āśānāmāśāpālāścatvāra sthana devāḥ te no nirṛtyāḥ pāśebhyo muñcatāṃhaso aṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye, Guardians of the regions, Gods who keep the quarters of the heavens, Rescue and free us from the bonds of Nirriti, from grief and woe!

verses.sa:
अस्रामस्त्वा हविषा यजाम्यश्लोणस्त्वा घृतेन जुहोमि ।
य आशानामाशापालस्तुरीयो देवः स नः सुभूतमेह वक्षत्॥
verses.tr: asrāmastvā haviṣā yajāmyaśloṇastvā ghṛtena juhomi ya āśānāmāśāpālasturīyo devaḥ sa naḥ subhūtameha vakṣat
verses.en: I, free from stiffness, serve thee with oblation, not lame I sacrifice with oil and fatness. Let the strong Warder God who keeps the regions. bring to us hither safety and well-being.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति मात्र उत पित्रे नो अस्तु स्वस्ति गोभ्यो जगते पुरुषेभ्यः ।
विश्वं सुभूतं सुविदत्रं नो अस्तु ज्योगेव दृशेम सूर्यम्॥
verses.tr: svasti mātra uta pitre no astu svasti gobhyo jagate puruṣebhyaḥ viśvaṃ subhūtaṃ suvidatraṃ no astu jyogeva dṛśema sūryam
verses.en: Well be it with our mother and our father, well be it with our cows, and beasts, and people. Ours be all happy fortune, race, and favour. Long, very long may we behold the sunlight.

sections.label: In praise of Heaven and Earth
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 32

verses.sa:
इदं जनासो विदथ महद् ब्रह्म वदिष्यति ।
न तत् पृथिव्यां नो दिवि येन प्राणन्ति वीरुधः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ janāso vidatha mahad brahma vadiṣyati na tat pṛthivyāṃ no divi yena prāṇanti vīrudhaḥ
verses.en: Ye people, hear and mark this well: he will pronounce a mighty prayer: That which gives breathing to the Plants is not on earth nor in the heaven.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्ष आसां स्थाम श्रान्तसदामिव ।
आस्थानमस्य भूतस्य विदुष्टद् वेधसो न वा॥
verses.tr: antarikṣa āsāṃ sthāma śrāntasadāmiva āsthānamasya bhūtasya viduṣṭad vedhaso na vā
verses.en: Their station, as of those who rest when weary, is in midmost air: The We whereon this world is built, the sages know or know it not.

verses.sa:
यद् रोदसी रेजमाने भूमिश्च निरतक्षतम्।
आर्द्रं तदद्य सर्वदा समुद्रस्येव स्रोत्याः॥
verses.tr: yad rodasī rejamāne bhūmiśca niratakṣatam ārdraṃ tadadya sarvadā samudrasyeva srotyāḥ
verses.en: What the two trembling hemispheres and ground produced and fashioned forth, This All, is ever fresh to-day, even as the currents of the sea.

verses.sa:
विश्वमन्यामभीवार तदन्यस्यामधिश्रितम्।
दिवे च विश्ववेदसे पृथिव्यै चाकरं नमः॥
verses.tr: viśvamanyāmabhīvāra tadanyasyāmadhiśritam dive ca viśvavedase pṛthivyai cākaraṃ namaḥ
verses.en: This All hath compassed round the one, and on the other lies at rest. To Earth and all-possessing Heaven mine adoration have I paid.

sections.label: To the Waters, for health and happiness
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 33

verses.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयः पावका यासु जातः सविता यास्वग्निः ।
या अग्निं गर्भं दधिरे सुवर्णास्ता न आपः शं स्योना भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ savitā yāsvagniḥ yā agniṃ garbhaṃ dadhire suvarṇāstā na āpaḥ śaṃ syonā bhavantu
verses.en: May they, the golden-hued, the bright, the splendid, they wherein Savitar was born and Agni, They who took Agni as a germ, fair-coloured, the Waters, bring felicity and bless us!

verses.sa:
यासां राजा वरुणो याति मध्ये सत्यानृते अवपश्यन् जनानाम्।
या अग्निं गर्भं दधिरे सुवर्णास्ता न आपः शं स्योना भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: yāsāṃ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyan janānām yā agniṃ garbhaṃ dadhire suvarṇāstā na āpaḥ śaṃ syonā bhavantu
verses.en: They in the midst whereof King Varuna moveth, viewing men's righteous and unrighteous dealing, They who took Agni as a germ, fair-coloured, those Waters bring felicity and bless us!

verses.sa:
यासां देवा दिवि कृण्वन्ति भक्षं या अन्तरिक्षे बहुधा भवन्ति ।
या अग्निं गर्भं दधिरे सुवर्णास्ता न आपः शं स्योना भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: yāsāṃ devā divi kṛṇvanti bhakṣaṃ yā antarikṣe bahudhā bhavanti yā agniṃ garbhaṃ dadhire suvarṇāstā na āpaḥ śaṃ syonā bhavantu
verses.en: Whom the Gods make their beverage in heaven, they who wax manifold in air's mid-region, They who took Agni as a germ, fair-coloured,—those Waters bring felicity and bless us!

verses.sa:
शिवेन मा चक्षुषा पश्यतापः शिवया तन्वोप स्पृशत त्वचं मे ।
घृतश्चुतः शुचयो याः पावकास्ता न आपः शं स्योना भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyatāpaḥ śivayā tanvopa spṛśata tvacaṃ me ghṛtaścutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakāstā na āpaḥ śaṃ syonā bhavantu
verses.en: Ye Waters, with auspicious eye behold me: touch ye my skin with your auspicious body. May they, the bright and pure, distilling fatness, those Waters, bring felicity and bless us.

sections.label: A young man's love-charm
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 34

verses.sa:
इयं वीरुन्मधुजाता मधुना त्वा खनामसि ।
मधोरधि प्रजातासि सा नो मधुमतस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ vīrunmadhujātā madhunā tvā khanāmasi madhoradhi prajātāsi sā no madhumataskṛdhi
verses.en: From honey sprang this Plant to life: with honey now we dig thee up. Make us as sweet as honey, for from honey hast thou been produced.

verses.sa:
जिह्वाया अग्रे मधु मे जिह्वामूले मधूलकम्।
ममेदह क्रतावसो मम चित्तमुपायसि॥
verses.tr: jihvāyā agre madhu me jihvāmūle madhūlakam mamedaha kratāvaso mama cittamupāyasi
verses.en: My tongue hath honey at the tip, and sweetest honey at the root: Thou yieldest to my wish and will, and shalt be mine and only mine.

verses.sa:
मधुमन्मे निक्रमणं मधुमन्मे परायणम्।
वाचा वदामि मधुमद् भूयासं मधुसंदृशः॥
verses.tr: madhumanme nikramaṇaṃ madhumanme parāyaṇam vācā vadāmi madhumad bhūyāsaṃ madhusaṃdṛśaḥ
verses.en: My coming in is honey-sweet, and honey-sweet my going forth: My voice and words are sweet: I fain would be like honey in my look.

verses.sa:
मधोरस्मि मधुतरो मदुघान्मधुमत्तरः ।
मामित् किल त्वं वनाः शाखां मधुमतीमिव॥
verses.tr: madhorasmi madhutaro madughānmadhumattaraḥ māmit kila tvaṃ vanāḥ śākhāṃ madhumatīmiva
verses.en: Sweeter am I than honey, yet more full of sweets than licorice: So mayst thou love me as a branch full of all sweets, and only me.

verses.sa:
परि त्वा परितत्नुनेक्षुणागामविद्विषे ।
यथा मां कामिन्यसो यथा मन्नापगा असः॥
verses.tr: pari tvā paritatnunekṣuṇāgāmavidviṣe yathā māṃ kāminyaso yathā mannāpagā asaḥ
verses.en: Around thee have I girt a zone of sugar-cane to banish hate, That thou mayst be in love with me, my darling, never to depart.

sections.label: A charm to ensure long life and glory to the wearer of an amulet
sections.name: Book 1, hymn 35

verses.sa:
यदाबध्नन् दाक्षायणा हिरण्यं शतानीकाय सुमनस्यमानाः ।
तत् ते बध्नाम्यायुषे वर्चसे बलाय दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय॥
verses.tr: yadābadhnan dākṣāyaṇā hiraṇyaṃ śatānīkāya sumanasyamānāḥ tat te badhnāmyāyuṣe varcase balāya dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya
verses.en: This Ornament of Gold which Daksha's children bound, with benevolent thoughts, on Satanika, This do I bind on thee for life, for glory, for long life lasting through a hundred autumns. My coming in my going forth: all my doings; my general conduct. I

verses.sa:
नैनं रक्षांसि न पिशाचाः सहन्ते देवानामोजः प्रथमजं ह्येतत्।
यो बिभर्ति दाक्षायणं हिरण्यं स जीवेषु कृणुते दीर्घमायुः॥
verses.tr: nainaṃ rakṣāṃsi na piśācāḥ sahante devānāmojaḥ prathamajaṃ hyetat yo bibharti dākṣāyaṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ sa jīveṣu kṛṇute dīrghamāyuḥ
verses.en: This man no fiends may conquer, no Pisachas, for this is might of Gods, their primal offspring. Whoever wears the Gold of Daksha's children hath a long lengthened life among the living.

verses.sa:
अपां तेजो ज्योतिरोजो बलं च वनस्पतीनामुत वीर्याऽणि ।
इन्द्र इवेन्द्रियाण्यधि धारयामो अस्मिन् तद् दक्षमाणो बिभरद्धिरण्यम्॥
verses.tr: apāṃ tejo jyotirojo balaṃ ca vanaspatīnāmuta vīryā'ṇi indra ivendriyāṇyadhi dhārayāmo asmin tad dakṣamāṇo bibharaddhiraṇyam
verses.en: The light, the power, the lustre of the Waters, the strength of Trees, and all their forceful vigour, We lay on him as powers hide in Indra: so let him wear this Gold and show his valour.

verses.sa:
समानां मासामृतुभिष्ट्वा वयं संवत्सरस्य पयसा पिपर्मि ।
इन्द्राग्नी विश्वे देवास्तेऽनु मन्यन्तामहृणीयमानाः॥
verses.tr: samānāṃ māsāmṛtubhiṣṭvā vayaṃ saṃvatsarasya payasā piparmi indrāgnī viśve devāste'nu manyantāmahṛṇīyamānāḥ
verses.en: With monthly and six-monthly times and seasons, with the full years1 sweet essence do we fill thee. May Indra, Agni, and all Gods together, showing no anger, grant thee what thou wishest.
